name: agent-write-guard
description: Denies implementer file edits on the test tree and test-author file edits on production code, so each agent stays on its side of the test boundary. Also guards gate configuration (ruff, mypy, import-linter, pre-commit files) from the implementer through the gate-configuration rule, with modes off, observe (default), and enforce.

gateConfigMode.title: Gate-configuration rule mode
gateConfigMode.description: How the gate-configuration rule treats implementer edits to linter, type-checker, and pre-commit config files: off, observe (allow and log one line), or enforce (deny).
